measurements: activation distribution and saturation by layer and sampling view
GRU reset/update/candidate trajectories and effective retention-time proxy
effective rank and participation ratio by representation and view
trajectory-held-out linear probes for event support, exact phase and voltage residual
activation-gradient norm and sparsity at hidden and decoder layers

probe_control.selection: fixed before Kaggle execution; no validation hyperparameter search
probe_control.feature_scaling: training trajectories only within each outer fold
probe_control.duplicate_policy: remove repeated trajectory/time coordinates before fitting

decision_rules.readout_branch: hidden phase correlation >=0.5 and held-out event residual RMSE improves >=20%, while decoder representation loses either capability
decision_rules.objective_exposure_branch: hidden and decoder retain phase/amplitude capability; DG-01 then authorizes the sampler x balanced-objective factorial
decision_rules.information_contract_branch: hidden phase correlation <0.2 and event residual improvement <5% across checkpoint families despite broad-support AUROC >=0.7
decision_rules.inconclusive: capability changes sign across held-out trajectories or probe sample support is insufficient

guardrails: no teacher state enters any frozen model
teacher voltage and spikes are probe labels only
probe evaluation is held out by trajectory
duplicate overlapping manifest coordinates are removed before probing
no test trajectory and no checkpoint optimizer update
